name: Testimonial Drag Carousel
description: A centered header over a full-bleed, infinitely draggable testimonial carousel with momentum: tall photo cards with caption overlays; video cards reveal a glassy Play pill on hover.
interactions: infinite drag carousel: the offset wraps over the loop width (3 duplicated sets) with velocity momentum decay; clicks suppressed after drag; hover on video cards fades the caption to a Play pill; __sectionUpdate sets an absolute offset; prefers-reduced-motion drops the photo zoom
